LanguageData.RKU_RawAllurecap.label: Allurecap
LanguageData.RKU_RawAllurecap.description: Freshly harvested allurecap, can be used to manufacture a potent stimulant that rapidly excites the nervous system, possessing considerable potential for weaponisation. It may also be directly administered during surgical procedures to induce amnesia, though this carries additional side effects.
LanguageData.RKU_RawSingularitycap.label: Antigraincap Spore
LanguageData.RKU_RawSingularitycap.description: Antigraincap's spores can be blended into a remarkably potent gun powder, possessing considerable potential for weaponisation.
